title: Filters panel (drop shadow, glow, blur)
description: Filters panel for selected display objects: drop shadow, glow, blur, bevel, gradient glow, gradient bevel, adjust color. Flash 8 Filters panel UI: add/remove/enable/disable per filter, parameter sliders. Render filters via Canvas 2D (CSS filter approximation or manual). Store FilterDef[] on DisplayObject. See docs/08-filters-blend-modes.md. Depends on selection-transform, stage-shape-rendering.
